This rider changes the coverage in your certificate. Your rider and certificate
are meant to be read together. It is important to review these changes to
understand how your coverage has changed.
Section 2: What You Must Pay
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider adds deductible and coinsurance requirements for covered services.
It also explains what your annual benefit maximum is.
Replace the first paragraph of the
Deductible Requirements subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Deductible Requirements
The deductible is the amount you must pay for certain covered services
each calendar year before we pay for services.
There is no deductible requirement for services provided by a Tier 1 PPO
(in-network) dentist under this rider.
You must pay the following deductibles for Class II and III services
performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists:
• $50 for one member
• $100 for two members
• $150 for a family (three or more members)
When the deductible for any one member has been met, we will
pay for covered services only for that member until the full
family deductible has been met.
We will not apply payments toward your deductible if one of the following applies:
• The payment is for a charge that exceeds our approved amount.
• The payment is for a non-covered service.

Replace the first paragraph of the
Coinsurance Requirements subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Coinsurance Requirements
You must pay these coinsurances for covered services performed by Tier 1
PPO (in-network) dentists:
• No coinsurance for Class I services
• 30% of the approved amount for Class II services
• 50% of the approved amount for Class III services
You must pay the following coinsurances for services provided by non-
PPO (out-of-network) dentists:
• 20% of the approved amount for Class I services
• 40% of the approved amount for Class II services
• 50% of the approved amount for Class III services
We will not apply a coinsurance to:
• The difference between our approved amount and the dentist’s charge.
• Non-covered services.

pages.raw_text:
Replace the sentence under the
Annual Benefit Maximum subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Annual Benefit Maximum
The annual benefit maximum under this rider is $1,200 per non-pediatric
member, of which only $1,000 can be used for services performed by non-
PPO (out-of-network) dentists. It applies to Class I, II and III dental services
that are provided by either Tier 1 PPO (in-network) or non-PPO (out-of-
network) dentists.
The annual maximum does not apply to pediatric members.
